rationale: FBIN gapped up ~4.9% despite a negative earnings miss (EPS and revenue both below estimates, significant YoY earnings decline), creating a contradictory setup where the stock is now fading from the session high ($49.46) back toward mid-range ($47.33), sitting below the 9-EMA ($47.44) and well above VWAP ($46.89). The 1-minute tape shows choppy, directionless price action with no clear momentum in either direction, and with 116 minutes to close and a wide intraday range already established, the risk/reward for either a long (fighting the earnings-miss narrative and downward fade) or short (fighting the broad market rally with SPY +1.73% and VIXY -9.63%) is insufficient to justify a new position.
